description: This file contains a class and function for rewriting do-while loops into an equivalent form to improve shader compiler compatibility. It defines a loop transformation that replaces do-while loops with a while loop and conditional break statements, using AST traversal.

classes.name: DoWhileRewriter
classes.description: AST traverser class that rewrites do-while loops into while loops with break conditions.

methods.name: visitBlock
methods.description: Traverses AST blocks to find and replace do-while loops.

methods.name: RewriteDoWhile
methods.description: Main function that applies the do-while rewriting transformation to the AST.
